If \(r\) is the inradius (radius of sphere tangent to all four faces),
\[
V=\frac13 rS \Rightarrow r=\frac{3V}{S}=\frac{1080}{384}=\frac{45}{16}.
\]

By symmetry the incenter \(R\) lies on the \(x\)-axis.  
Plane \(ABC\): \(3x+4z=-18\Rightarrow 3x+4z+18=0\).  
Distance to \((x,0,0)\) is \(|3x+18|/5\).  
Plane \(ACD\): \(5x-12y=30\Rightarrow 5x-12y-30=0\).  
Distance is \(|5x-30|/13\).

Set both equal to \(45/16\) and inside:
\[
\frac{|3x+18|}{5}=\frac{|5x-30|}{13}=\frac{45}{16}\Rightarrow x=-\frac{21}{16}.
\]
So
\[
R=\left(-\frac{21}{16},0,0\right),\qquad \rho=\frac{45}{16}.
\]

### Circumsphere
Need \(S=(s,0,0)\) with \(|SA|=|SC|\):
\[
(s+6)^2+25=(s-6)^2+81\Rightarrow 24s=56\Rightarrow s=\frac73.
\]
Thus
\[
S=\left(\frac73,0,0\right),\quad R^2=\left(\frac73-6\right)^2+81=\frac{850}{9}.
\]

Check \(|SB|=|SD|\) same, so this is the unique circumsphere.
